fullDescription: An editorial-inspired design system blending brutalist typography with high-end engineering aesthetics. It features high-contrast color palettes (navy, deep teal, and taupe), massive display titles, and sophisticated micro-interactions. Suitable for high-tech industries, AI research labs, engineering firms, premium SaaS platforms, and architectural studios that require a sense of scale and precision.

structured.summary: A sophisticated, high-contrast UI design system utilizing 'Anton' for bold display headlines and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for refined body copy. The aesthetic is defined by large-scale typography, a custom crosshair cursor, floating blurred background elements, and smooth scroll-triggered reveal animations.

style.description: The style is characterized by a 'tech-editorial' look. It uses a deep color palette (#171e19, #1a3a52) paired with neutral taupe (#9f8d8b) and crisp white. Typography relies on 'Anton' for massive, uppercase headers and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for wide-tracked, small-caps metadata (10px size with 0.3em letter spacing). Interactive elements feature cubic-bezier transitions (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and distinctive image hover states.
style.prompt: Create a design system with the following specs: **Colors**: Primary Navy (#171e19), Deep Teal/Sage (#1a3a52), Taupe (#9f8d8b), Charcoal (#302b2f), Soft Blue (#3a7ab8), and White (#FFFFFF). **Typography**: Headers use 'Anton', Sans-Serif, uppercase, tracking-tighter. Body text uses 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Metadata should be 10px, uppercase, tracking 0.3em to 0.4em. **Cursors**: Global 'crosshair'. **Animations**: Use 'cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)' for all transitions. Implement floating background blobs with blur(120px) at 20% opacity. Scroll reveals should translate 20px Y-axis with 1s duration. **UI Elements**: Buttons are hollow with 1px white/40% borders and text-only with wide tracking.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout uses a combination of full-bleed hero sections, asymmetric grids for portfolio/work displays, and spacious editorial sections with high vertical padding (py-32 to py-40).

prompts.prompt: Fixed top navigation, full width, px-8 py-6. Use 'mix-blend-difference' to ensure visibility against changing backgrounds. Left-aligned logo in Anton 2xl. Right-aligned links (10px, uppercase, 0.3em tracking) including a 'Partner With Us' button with a 1px border.

H-screen relative container. Background color #1a3a52. Centered massive typography stack: Top word solid white Anton (18vw), bottom word Anton (18vw) with a 1px stroke in #69b6e2 and transparent fill. Include two blurred floating blobs (#1a3a52 and #3a7ab8) moving in a 6s 'float' animation. Bottom-left metadata paragraph (max-width 420px, 10px tracking-widest).

2-column asymmetric grid. Even-numbered items should have a top margin (md:mt-16) to create a staggered effect. Images are aspect-ratio [3/4]. Hovering an image triggers: 1. Image scale(1.1), 2. Overlay opacity(0.6), 3. Appearance of a centered white circular 'VIEW' badge (w-24 h-24) using scale(1) from scale(0.8).

Grid layout (12 columns). Left side (4 cols) contains a list of services. Each service has a leading horizontal line (1px navy) that expands from 40px to 64px on hover. Right side (8 cols) features a large-scale (text-6xl) light-weight navy headline with italicized taupe highlights.

Background #302b2f (Charcoal). Massive background quotation mark in navy (#171e19) at 30rem size. Centered blockquote in white Anton text-6xl. Footer of the quote includes a circular avatar with a 1px white/20% border and metadata in white and taupe.

Background #1a3a52. Massive 'Ready to Build' headline. The primary contact email should be Anton text-8xl, white, with a custom underline (offset-16px, decoration-white/30). Bottom bar contains copyright and social links in 10px uppercase white/40% text.

special_ui_components.description: A vertical image card with sophisticated hover layers.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: overflow-hidden. Element 1: Image with transition-duration-700. Element 2: Navy overlay (#171e19) at 0 opacity. Element 3: Centered white circle with 'VIEW' text (Anton, sm). Interaction: On hover, image scales 1.1, overlay goes to 0.6 opacity, and badge scales from 0.8 to 1.0 with opacity 1.

special_ui_components.description: Navigational or capability list items with motion-sensitive indicators.
special_ui_components.prompt: Horizontal layout: 1px height line followed by Anton text-xl. The line has a base width of 40px. On hover of the parent container, the line expands to 64px using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
